admission.justification: Future changes to task-page reads, conditional transport, native generation capture or retained-content ownership must prevent stale or unbounded cache reuse and a counter failure blocking the document. Named current source assertions guard the specified facets; historical timing/count samples remain task-local, not enduring obligations or fresh Curator grades.

applicability: The introduced server/browser response-content retention owners, top-level generation tables and pending-read collections.
conditions: Server result/repository/object-observation tables and per-read observations/pending values use the named capacity; full-body retention also uses its byte limit.
Browser body/preparation and conditional result owners enforce their named entry/byte limits; excess pending reads are cancelled and late aborted results cannot be retained.
LRU eviction and oversized-result nonretention permit the current answer without allowing navigation history to grow retained content indefinitely.
exclusions: Named bounded content tables are distinct from the native repository corpus they observe and the independent observer/event stores.
Historical producer run/capacity samples are not assertions of current configured limits or fresh Curator execution.
statement: Every retained server/browser content store and pending-read set has a named LRU or cancellation bound.
